label: Сказка
description: A 10-sentence usage card for сказка (fairy tale).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Сказка' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the predicate. 'Любимая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'моя' marks possession.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Сказку' is the accusative direct object of 'рассказала'. 'Интересную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive modifier. 'Сказки' is the genitive showing whose ending it is, modifying 'конца'. A natural part-whole relationship.
Strategic focus: Dative complement. 'Сказке' is the dative governed by 'радуются'. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine dative, naming the source of joy.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Сказку' takes the accusative after 'под' in the sense of falling asleep to the sound of a tale.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Сказке' is the prepositional form after 'о'. 'Старой' agrees in the feminine prepositional, marking the topic.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Сказку' takes the accusative after 'на' in the construction 'похож на', expressing resemblance to a fairy tale.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Сказки' is the inanimate accusative plural object of 'любят', matching the nominative plural. 'Русские' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Сказок' is the genitive plural required after 'много', with a fleeting vowel inserted. 'Добрых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Сказку' takes the accusative after 'на' in 'похожа на', comparing life to a fairy tale. 'Похожа' agrees with the feminine subject 'жизнь'.
